name: textkit
description: Engine for the textkit skill: a shared text-processing core shipping five CLIs on PATH — distill-text (distill a note into its typed knowledge graph), polish-text (copy-edit prose), card-stage (stage extraction candidates from a distilled note), simplify-text (analyze a note against the Simplified style and print a restyle brief), and simplify-verify (deterministically gate a restyle's applied rewrite — reference spans and structure must survive). See SKILL.md.
